title: I implemented a neural network in SQL
claim: Show HN: I implemented a neural network in SQL
why_good: Integrating neural networks directly into SQL databases could streamline data processing for organizations already reliant on SQL, making AI more accessible.
value: Companies could pay for a subscription service that enhances their existing SQL databases with AI capabilities, driving efficiency in data analysis and decision-making.
risk: The project may struggle to scale as a standalone company if larger database providers integrate similar AI functionalities directly into their products.
